artwork.description: Myth-inspired traditional Japanese painting map. Approximate placement only; not a surveyed coastline or an archaeological reconstruction.
artwork.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: illustrated map for an interactive Kobe history atlas. Create an exquisite old Japanese painting style MAP of Awaji Island, Japan: north-up, recognizable elongated island oriented northeast to southwest, narrow northern tip at top-right and wider mountainous southern half at bottom-left. Entire island visible surrounded by pale sea; faint partial Kobe/Honshu coast near the top-right and Shikoku coast near bottom-left edge only. Bird's-eye map composition, softly inked coastline, layered green-grey mountain ridges, miniature historical Japanese landscape details, delicate wave brushwork. Traditional sumi ink and restrained mineral pigments on warm ivory washi, subtle gold accents in the sea, authentic hand-painted scroll feeling, not a modern satellite image. Tall portrait composition with ample sea margins. No labels, no lettering, no seals, no modern roads, no bridges, no text. This is a myth-inspired illustrative map, not an archaeological reconstruction. Clouds will be drawn separately by the website, so do not cover the island with clouds.
